text: Doctor Nia Veran holds the role of Chief Medical Officer of the Judicator Prime within Galactic Union (federation). Decision archetype: Humanitarian, Advocates for Crew Well-Being Over Strict Military Efficiency.
Core traits: Highly Compassionate, Tactical in Medical Crises, Calm Under Pressure. Voice — tone: calm; cadence: measured. Avoids: callousness toward casualties, military-over-medical prioritization.
Assigned to G.U.S. Judicator Prime (Galactic Union Supercarrier). Core values: crew welfare, medical ethics, calm under fire. Faction — military: 0.80, economic: 0.80, technology: 0.70.
